# Struct `puc::tui::Screen::EventBuffer`

Fixed-capacity, thread-safe FIFO shared by event producers and [Screen](classpuc_1_1tui_1_1_screen.md).

All `kMaxEvents` array slots are usable. `read_index` and `write_index` wrap modulo capacity while `size` distinguishes empty from full.
